2401.title: Editing a queued message can lock the desktop renderer at 100% CPU and >10 GiB RSS
2401.rootCauseOneLine: The Linux Chrome callback path stopped, but the available evidence does not identify the macOS Electron microtask that caused the lock.

prReviews.topFinding: The frame limit is sound protection, but the branch does not fix the hang and cannot capture its non-yielding JavaScript stack.

2401.proposedFix: First run the exact trigger on macOS Electron 0.39.0 with the reporter's plugins and content. Use a system process sample because the pinned renderer might not answer DevTools. If the observer does not stop, limit it to one read and one write per frame.
2401.caveats: The test used Linux Chrome, not macOS Electron 0.39.0. The exact queue content, plugin set, motion setting, and process samples were unavailable. The install reached the inode limit, so the run used an identical dependency tree.

2370.title: tell --mode auto injects into busy turn instead of queueing: provider error retry loop, status flips to error while turn continues
2370.rootCauseOneLine: A five-second pending-start timeout returns a generic error, and the server drops the input and fails the healthy thread.
2370.proposedFix: Return a typed pending-start busy error. Keep the live status, park refused input, and retry after the turn ID arrives.
2370.caveats: PR #2379 fixed the original active-turn injection at the base. Tests reproduced the residual daemon and server paths. No live provider or production transcripts were available.

2362.title: File listing crashes with 502 on large workspaces (Maximum call stack size exceeded)
2362.rootCauseOneLine: listPathsRecursively spreads a large child-result array into Array.push, so V8 rejects the argument count and the server returns HTTP 502.

prReviews.topFinding: The loop fixes the root cause. The 150,000-file regression test has a low temporary-volume resource risk.

2362.proposedFix: Merge PR #2363. Then consider a shared recursive accumulator to avoid child arrays and repeated copies while preserving path order and filters.
2362.caveats: The shared /tmp file system had only 14 free inodes. The revised steps use an isolated /var/tmp directory and state the inode requirement. The public artifact URL remains unavailable until publication, so publication must confirm HTTP 200. All 560 host-daemon tests and the typecheck passed.

2343.title: Packaged Nightly plugin processes lose PATH for node and gh
2343.rootCauseOneLine: The shared probe can time out after shell exit when a child holds its pipe, then discard valid PATH data.
2343.proposedFix: Use an asynchronous probe with marked output. Stop on shell exit after a short pipe-drain limit. Accept complete marked output. Add a no-output fallback. Merge user and system path entries. Show a degraded state. Add real-process and macOS tests.
2343.caveats: This Linux host could not run the signed macOS Nightly through the Dock. The test proves a shared code failure only. It does not prove the reported macOS cause. origin/main is newer, but the affected files did not change. No open pull request links to the issue. Closed PR #2415 did not merge.

2551.title: Project picker dropdown does not scroll: projects past the window bottom are unreachable
2551.rootCauseOneLine: ProjectSelector renders all projects in a desktop menu with hidden overflow, but it sets no height limit or scroll behavior.
2551.proposedFix: Cap the desktop ProjectSelector menu with the Radix available-height variable. Add overflow-y-auto and overscroll-contain. Add desktop and compact regression tests.
2551.caveats: The issue does not give the reporter's bb version. I reproduced the same frontend in Linux Chrome, not macOS Electron. origin/main advanced to 1d97c63ed13b5231c1051b7af7ac36661d1f65ab, but no later commit changed the fault paths.

2547.title: bb-plugin-authoring skill documents bb.sdk.threads.list as returning { threads }; it returns an array
2547.rootCauseOneLine: The skill treats the threads.list array response as an object because no test compiled its SDK examples.

prReviews.topFinding: The regression test fails on the old line and passes after the fix. The PR also merges with current main without conflicts.

2547.proposedFix: Assign the threads.list result directly, and compile documented SDK destructuring against BbPluginApi in a regression test.
2547.caveats: The revised local copy steps saved all three required files and matched both saved outputs. Public download commands will work after report publication. Eight unrelated full-server tests timed out under load. The isolated install and build passed. Cleanup removed the worktree and dev data, and all assigned ports are free.
